verdict.rationale: Honeybadger lets users define Alarms, which pair a BadgerQL query with a threshold and fire alerts when it is exceeded. It also ships built-in automatic behaviors: errors auto-resolve when a deploy is recorded, and anomaly detection flags unusual error volume. Outbound webhooks are referenced as a delivery channel. However, the user-defined rules only trigger alerts or notifications, and the deploy auto-resolve is a fixed default rather than a rule users compose. Missing for 10: a general rule engine with configurable conditions mapped to arbitrary actions (e.g., auto-assign, auto-create issue, run workflow), detailed docs on rule and action configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
